strategy_change.previous_gap: media integrity was modeled, but locality-level seasonal food corridors and creator-to-place geographic resolution remained underrepresented
query_rotation: Patna seasonal food corridor locality creator 2026
Patna food creator reels locality dish 2026

findings.claim: A March 2026 Delhi Food Walks episode documents Sabzibagh as a Ramadan food hub, with a multi-stop route covering lachcha, Rahmania Hotel, Bismillah Hotel, Kalkatia Bakery, Royal Tea Stall, Dilnawaz Hotel, Manhangu Hotel, Shan-e-Helal Hotel, Paris Darbar and Royal Biryani.
findings.product_implication: Locality pages should support seasonal food states and route-level evidence rather than treating every food corridor as permanently active.

findings.claim: The Sabzibagh food walk identifies Fahmi from Unzip Patna as the local host, creating a strong creator-to-locality relationship with explicit geographic resolution.
findings.product_implication: Creator records should capture host/editorial role separately from audience size and link creators to specific locality routes.

findings.claim: A March 2026 Reddit litti hunt identifies Chaurasiya Litti and Gopi Krishna Litti around the Mahavir Mandir/GPO Golambar locality, plus a separate rustic street-style cluster near the RJD office and a softer-style litti signal around Maurya Lok.
findings.product_implication: Community submissions can provide micro-location leads that are difficult to discover through editorial guides, but each lead should remain unverified until corroborated.

findings.claim: Current third-party creator indexes show multiple Patna food creators with materially different audience sizes, including @urgeforfood, @patna_paradise_, @bihari_maai, @happiness_on_my_plate and @foodie_robin_.
findings.product_implication: Creator ranking should not use follower count alone; Crave Hunt should weight locality resolution, dish specificity, source quality and recency.

findings.claim: Mapiefood positions a personal food map around saved places, taste profiles and friend-based recommendations, reinforcing the value of persistent personal food memory as a product layer.
findings.product_implication: Crave Hunt can differentiate personal saves through evidence-aware context such as dish, locality, season, source and confidence rather than generic restaurant bookmarking.

dedupe_actions: No new canonical venue records were created from the Sabzibagh video; its stops are retained as media-linked place leads/observations.
Creator audience figures remain observations from third-party indexes and are not treated as stable creator attributes.
The Reddit litti recommendations remain community signals rather than verified place facts.
next_build: Add seasonal corridor and route evidence to locality pages, with creator host roles and dated media observations visible separately from permanent place status.
